scope: Actual transport bear/cloth held fixed, bear translated exactly to the sole counterfactual planned endpoint. Not actual descent, deformed response, force feasibility or whole-tet containment. This is only final node/COM low-region evidence. Keys named actual in the generic diagnostic refer to supplied frozen query data, not a native endpoint.

thresholds.tolerance_scope: Explicit diagnostic numerical guards, not a relaxation of physical contact or penetration limits

reasons: At least one teddy vertex or COM does not have unit winding in both caps

original_body_topology.body_face_selection: explicit physical body-face labels mapped to imported rest mesh

cap_winding.query_order: All actual bear vertices in saved order, followed by actual mass COM

physical_cloth_query_distance.method: Exact closest triangle point for each queried bear vertex and COM; no continuous whole-bear certificate
